statement: Conditions read the request's host attributes: `http.header.<name>`, `http.origin`, `http.referer` and their hosts (in lower case) from the request's headers, and `request.attributes.<name>` from what the adapter knows besides HTTP (the gateway's route id). A DENY on them applies, and an ALLOW gated on them permits; they are never read as absent when the request carries them. A header sent more than once with the same value is that value; one sent with different values has none (PIP-12).
guards: spring-boot:WebAdapterParityTest#the three adapters give the engine the same host attributes
spring-boot:WebAdapterParityTest#the gateway gives the engine the route id
